### 🟢 Approval recommended The focused guards preserve nonblank-argument behavior, with no blocking issues identified.
1 open issue - [Add regression test for empty and whitespace tool arguments](https://github.com/microsoft/semantic-kernel/pull/14635#discussion_r4333538863) · New
What changed in this PR Aligns non-streaming .NET tool-call handling with streaming behavior by treating empty or whitespace arguments as no arguments. **Changes:** - Adds guards in OpenAI Chat Completion, Responses, and Mistral conversions. - Preserves existing malformed-JSON handling. - Adds regression tests for empty arguments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | dotnet/​src/​Connectors/​Connectors.OpenAI/​Core/​ClientCore.ChatCompletion.cs | Skips deserialization for blank arguments. | | dotnet/​src/​Connectors/​Connectors.OpenAI.UnitTests/​Services/​OpenAIChatCompletionEmptyToolArgumentsTests.cs | Tests empty and whitespace chat tool arguments. | | dotnet/​src/​Connectors/​Connectors.MistralAI/​Extensions/​MistralAIPluginCollectionExtensions.cs | Treats blank arguments as absent during function lookup. | | dotnet/​src/​Connectors/​Connectors.MistralAI/​Client/​MistralClient.cs | Handles blank arguments when creating function-call content. | | dotnet/​src/​Connectors/​Connectors.MistralAI.UnitTests/​MistralAIPluginCollectionExtensionsTests.cs | Tests lookup with empty and whitespace arguments. | | dotnet/​src/​Agents/​UnitTests/​OpenAI/​Extensions/​OpenAIResponseExtensionsTests.cs | Tests empty arguments in both Responses conversions. | | dotnet/​src/​Agents/​OpenAI/​Extensions/​OpenAIResponseExtensions.cs | Guards both Responses conversion paths. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: Optional: add a client-level regression test in `MistralClientTests` for empty and whitespace tool arguments. The new Mistral tests call `TryGetFunctionAndArguments` directly, so reverting this separate guard would leave them passing while returned `FunctionCallContent` items again carry an invalid-JSON exception. Use a mocked tool-call response and assert that the returned item's `Arguments` and `Exception` are both null.
